description: Trade settlement date calculator — US trade settlement date for a trade date: T+1 for stocks, ETFs, options, corporate and muni bonds (T+2 before 2024-05-28, T+3 before 2017-09-05), T+1 Treasuries on the Fed calendar, FX spot T+2 (T+1 for USD/CAD). Skips weekends, NYSE holidays (incl. Good Friday) and bank holidays when the market is open (Columbus Day, Veterans Day). Params: trade_date=YYYY-MM-DD (default next trading day in New York), type=equity|etf|option|corporate-bond|muni|mutual-fund|treasury|agency-bond|fx|cash, pair=USD/CAD, days= override, record_date= returns the ex-dividend date and last day to buy. Offline. Price: $0.002 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: finance_settlement_date
